# HubForge Playbooks

> Free HubForge playbooks about dashboard design, surveys and forms, AI-assisted workflows, and evidence-based decisions. Each title has a readable web version and a downloadable PDF.

Published by HubForge Global Impact Network Foundation. The library currently contains three playbooks. These are educational resources, not a dashboard-hosting service.

## Library

- [Library overview](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/index.md): Available titles and how to choose a playbook.

## Playbooks

- [Designing Dashboards with AI](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/designing-dashboards/index.md): Summary of the six-stage DESIGN framework, exercises, and source links.
- [Claude Dashboard Playbook](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/claude-dashboards/index.md): Summary of prompts, data, evidence, and sharing topics with source links.

## Original sources

- [Designing Surveys and Forms with AI](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/designing-surveys-and-forms/index.md): The six-stage SURVEY method for monitoring forms and evaluation surveys, with a companion workbook, cheat sheet, and two XLSForm examples.
- [Surveys and Forms web playbook](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/designing-surveys-and-forms/): Original playbook and exercises.
- [Surveys and Forms workbook](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/designing-surveys-and-forms/workbook/): Thirteen working sheets and a survey design brief.
- [Surveys and Forms playbook PDF](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/designing-surveys-and-forms/playbook.pdf): 37-page playbook.
- [Surveys and Forms workbook PDF](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/designing-surveys-and-forms/workbook.pdf): 27-page workbook.
- [Surveys and Forms cheat sheet](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/designing-surveys-and-forms/cheat-sheet.pdf): One-page reference.

- [Designing Dashboards with AI web playbook](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/designing-dashboards/): Original content and working exercises.
- [Claude Dashboard Playbook web playbook](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/claude-dashboards/): Original content and working examples.
- [Designing Dashboards with AI PDF](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/designing-dashboards/playbook.pdf): 27-page downloadable edition.
- [Claude Dashboard Playbook PDF](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/claude-dashboards/playbook.pdf): 12-page downloadable edition.

## Optional

- [HubForge](https://www.hubforgeglobal.com): Publisher's main website.

## Consulting in Monitoring & Evaluation with AI

- [Web playbook](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/consulting-in-me-with-ai/): 18 chapters, the seven-stage CONSULT method, practical tools and AI prompts for M&E consultants.
- [Playbook summary](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/consulting-in-me-with-ai/index.md): Plain-text overview and resource links.
- [Playbook PDF](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/consulting-in-me-with-ai/playbook.pdf): 60 pages.
- [Template pack PDF](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/consulting-in-me-with-ai/template-pack.pdf): 81 pages with 36 printable templates.
- [From Zero to World-Class toolkit PDF](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/consulting-in-me-with-ai/consulting-toolkit.pdf): 94-page M&E consulting toolkit.
- [Cheat sheet PDF](https://playbooks.hubforgeglobal.com/consulting-in-me-with-ai/cheat-sheet.pdf): One-page CONSULT method reference from the supplied playbook.
